name: app.py
content:
from shiny import App, ui, render, reactive
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

crashes = pd.read_csv('basic-app/CAS_Data_public.csv')
# filter the data we needed
crashes = crashes[["X", "Y", "crashYear", "crashSeverity", "speedLimit"]]
print(crashes.columns)
#delete rows with missing value
crashes = crashes.dropna()

#year filter--choose 2024 to 2026
crashes = crashes[(crashes["crashYear"] >= 2024) & (crashes["crashYear"] <= 2026)]

# change the data type
crashes["crashYear"] = crashes["crashYear"].astype(int)
crashes["speedLimit"] = crashes["speedLimit"].astype(float)

crashes.shape

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.h2("Auckland Crash Severity Dashboard (2024–2026)"),
    ui.p("Use the filters below to explore crash patterns by year, severity, and speed limit."),
    
    # input1: year
    ui.input_slider("year", "Year", 2024, 2026, 2025),

    # input2: Severity
    ui.input_select(
        "severity", "Severity",
        ['All',"Non-Injury Crash", "Minor Crash", "Serious Crash", "Fatal Crash"]
    ),

    # input3: Speed Limit
    ui.input_slider(
        "speed", "Speed Limit",
        min=0, max=110, value=(0, 110)
    ),

    ui.output_text("summary"),
    ui.output_plot("chart"),
    ui.output_ui("map")   # ipyleaflet
)

def server(input, output, session):
    @reactive.calc
    def filtered():
        df = crashes
        # year filter
        df = df[df["crashYear"] == input.year()]

        # severity filter
        if input.severity() != "All":
            df = df[df["crashSeverity"] == input.severity()]

        # speed filter
        df = df[(df["speedLimit"] >= input.speed()[0]) & (df["speedLimit"] <= input.speed()[1])]
        return df

    @output
    @render.text
    def summary():
        df = filtered()
        if len(df) == 0:
            return "No crashes match the current filters."
        return f"{len(df)} crashes selected. Most are {df['crashSeverity'].mode()[0]}."
    
    @render.plot
    def chart():
        df = filtered()
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
        counts = df.groupby("speedLimit").size()
        counts.plot(kind="bar", ax=ax)

        ax.set_xlabel("Speed Limit")
        ax.set_ylabel("Number of Crashes")
        ax.set_title("Crashes by Speed Limit")

        plt.tight_layout()
        return fig

app = App(app_ui, server)
